lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno felt a flutter, oh my,
Did I swallow butterflies?
Kiki smiled, oh Bruno, no,
That's just nerves before the show!
[chorus]
Butterflies in your stomach, butterflies in your stomach,
Nervous feeling, flutter and hum!
Butterflies in your stomach, butterflies in your stomach,
Take a breath, your turn will come!
[verse]
It means you're nervous, jittery too,
Before a show or something new,
Take a breath and count to three,
Those butterflies will flutter free!
[chorus]
Butterflies in your stomach, butterflies in your stomach,
Nervous feeling, flutter and hum!
Butterflies in your stomach, butterflies in your stomach,
Smile big now, here we come!
[outro]
So when you're nervous, that's okay,
Let those butterflies dance away!
